detail: store.commit_edit writes module.json, then removes cache/edit/<id key>/; if the removal fails (a picture still locked), it logs and returns success, leaving state.json in phase 'committing'. The next added picture goes into the old added/ (duplicates seen in test_j20 under load); recover_edit on reopen would put start/ back, rolling back the saved map (reasoned from the code). Fix: mark the edit finished before removing the folder; clean a leftover added/ at the next begin; test that holds a picture open during commit_edit.
title: Button Map Save can leave its edit folder half-removed; a reopen could undo a Save that worked
